kinds.name: network_route
kinds.doc:
One way for traffic to leave, as configured. An instance is one configuration of one provider; the provider's settings are its
schema.

A provider that runs a program or a listener starts it in [`open`](Self::open) and ends it when the lease is destroyed. A
refusal says what the person can act on (a variable that is not set, a file that cannot be read, a program that did not start)
in words that hold no password and no query.

slots.name: describe
slots.doc: What it is. Cheap, and the same on every call.

slots.name: check
slots.doc:
Judges the settings with nothing started: a variable that is not set (`request.variables` lacks it), a file that is missing,
an address that does not parse.

slots.name: open
slots.doc: A lease for `request.scope`, started when the host holds none that serves it.

kinds.name: route_lease
kinds.doc: A route in use. Destroying it ends it.

slots.name: reach
slots.doc: How a connection of the host's own leaves.

slots.name: variables
slots.doc: Environment for a program that reaches `request.urls` on this lease, beyond what [`reach`](Self::reach) implies.

slots.name: trust
slots.doc: The authorities a program on this lease must trust, for a route that ends TLS.

slots.name: status
slots.doc: What the lease is doing, for a page.
